scope.pathway: ordinary new garden suite on a confirmed GRD-1 legal lot governed by Zoning Bylaw 2018

legal_lot.locator: Part 2.1 Lot and Lot Line, PDF p18
legal_lot.basis: registered lot and registered lot line; GIS parcel polygon alone is not proof

floor_area.basis: measured to interior surface of exterior walls; includes mezzanine, exterior hallway, exterior staircase, loft and partial storey; excludes listed balcony/veranda/deck/patio/roof, crawlspace/basement, rooftop structures and specified parking areas

setback.basis: shortest horizontal distance between classified lot line and building face; listed exclusions include cornices, retaining walls, fences, and up to 0.13 m of exterior wall treatment, insulation or rainscreen

front_line.locator: Part 2.1 Front Lot Line, PDF p16
front_line.basis: street, easement, corner-lot and multiple-street branches; long axis does not determine frontage

rear_line_and_yard.locator: Part 2.1 Rear Lot Line and Rear Yard, PDF p19
rear_line_and_yard.basis: rear line opposite front line, triangular point case; rear yard lies between principal building and rear line across lot width

flanking_line.locator: Part 2.1 Flanking Street Lot Line, PDF pp15-16
flanking_line.basis: street-adjacent lot line other than front or rear line

waterfront_lot.basis: lot abutting tidal water body at any boundary portion

source_locators: Part 2.2 Residential and Garden Suite, PDF pp21-22
rules.original: GRD-1 permits Residential; Garden Suite is a building attached to a foundation, used or designed as a dwelling unit on a lot with a single-detached dwelling or duplex
rules.measurement_basis: actual legal lot, use and controlled proposed foundation configuration
rules.explanation: Check that this lot and proposed building fit the ordinary GRD-1 garden-suite pathway.

rules.measurement_basis: existing garden suites plus this proposed suite on one legal lot
rules.explanation: A lot may have no more than one garden suite.

source_locators: Part 2.1 Setback and Side Lot Line, PDF p19
rules.measurement_basis: shortest horizontal distance from each classified side or rear registered lot line to the proposed building face, with only applicable feature exclusions
rules.explanation: Compare each identified side and rear lot line with the garden suite's building face.

source_locators: Part 2.1 Flanking Street Lot Line and Setback, PDF pp15-16 and p19
rules.measurement_basis: shortest horizontal distance from classified flanking street registered lot line to proposed building face
rules.explanation: If the lot has a flanking street line, check its separate setback.

rules.measurement_basis: separation space between proposed garden suite and identified principal building; exact endpoints are not defined in this clause and require City/source interpretation
rules.explanation: Check space between the garden suite and the principal building when both measured faces are known.

rules.measurement_basis: Part 2.1 Floor Area; interior surface of exterior walls and specified included/excluded areas, summed over applicable levels
rules.explanation: Compare the design's bylaw floor area with the 56 m² limit.
